tasks.label: git > save staged diff
tasks.detail: Saves the current staged changes into a diff log file for reference or review.

tasks.label: git > fetch all
tasks.detail: Fetches updates from all remotes and branches without merging.

tasks.label: git > create empty commit
tasks.detail: Creates an empty commit, useful for triggering workflows or CI/CD runs.

tasks.label: git > save staging..development --pretty
tasks.detail: Saves detailed commit messages between the development and staging branches in a readable format.

tasks.label: git > save staging..development --oneline
tasks.detail: Saves a condensed one-line list of commits between development and staging branches.

tasks.label: git > save production..staging --pretty
tasks.detail: Saves detailed commit messages between the staging and production branches for review before release.

tasks.label: git > save production..staging --oneline
tasks.detail: Saves a short one-line summary of commits between staging and production branches.

tasks.label: git > save development..production --pretty
tasks.detail: Saves detailed commit messages between the production and development branches for backtracking changes.

tasks.label: git > save development..production --oneline
tasks.detail: Saves a one-line summary of commits between production and development branches.

tasks.label: git > save all branches --pretty
tasks.detail: Saves detailed commit logs spanning from production to development.

tasks.label: git > save all branches --oneline
tasks.detail: Saves one-line commit summaries covering all branches from production to development.

tasks.label: next.js(web) > dev
tasks.detail: Starts the Web app in Next.js development mode with hot reloading for local iteration.

tasks.label: next.js(web) > build
tasks.detail: Builds the Web application for production, generating optimized static and server assets.

tasks.label: next.js(web) > start
tasks.detail: Runs the Web production server using the previously generated build output.

tasks.label: next.js(web) > lint
tasks.detail: Runs ESLint on the Web app to identify code quality issues and enforce project standards.

tasks.label: next.js(api) > dev
tasks.detail: Starts the API service in development mode with hot reloading for rapid backend iteration.

tasks.label: next.js(api) > build
tasks.detail: Compiles the API project for production, optimizing route handlers and server code.

tasks.label: next.js(api) > start
tasks.detail: Runs the API production server using the optimized build output.

tasks.label: next.js(api) > lint
tasks.detail: Runs ESLint on the API project to ensure backend code quality and consistency.

tasks.label: pnpm > outdated
tasks.detail: Lists dependencies that have newer versions available.

tasks.label: pnpm > update
tasks.detail: Updates all project dependencies to their latest compatible versions.

tasks.label: pnpm > install
tasks.detail: Installs all project dependencies as defined in the package.json file.
